jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Platform — Data Trust & AI Context
jobs.description:
**Employee Applicant Privacy Notice**

**Who we are:**

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we're changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We're a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we're at the forefront. We're proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people's lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. **Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.**

**The Role:**

SoFi's ability to deliver trusted member experiences, manage risk, meet regulatory obligations, and scale enterprise AI depends on data that is reliable, governed, understandable, and available when it is needed.

As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Group, you will provide hands-on technical leadership within the Data Trust pillar. Working alongside the Senior Manager and other Principal Engineers, you will design, build, and operate the distributed systems and reusable platform primitives that make data quality, privacy, metadata, lineage, access, and reliability enforceable by construction across the enterprise.

Your work will span three connected areas: establishing shared Data Trust capabilities, raising the reliability of data across batch and low-latency environments, and applying those foundations to a semantic context layer for trusted analytics and AI. By making business meaning, ownership, provenance, quality, freshness, and access policies machine-readable, you will help end users and AI systems work from consistent, governed context.

This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineer

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mid
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Mid

**The Opportunity:**  
Start your career as a full stack developer contributing to end‑to‑end solutions in a fast‑paced, agile environment. If you're eager to grow your engineering skills while supporting real mission impact, we need you on our team. You'll assist in developing software systems from early concepts to production‑ready solutions.

This role is more than just writing code. As a full stack developer at Booz Allen, you’ll learn modern tools, frameworks, and development practices while helping the team identify improvements, support system enhancements, and implement features under guidance. You'll solve technical challenges as part of a collaborative, cross‑functional engineering team.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

**You Have:**

* Experience in software development, including in an internship, academic, or professional work environment
* Experience with software design, modification, development, or implementation using agile methods, including in an internship, academic, or professional work environment
* Experience with writing source code for new applications or contributing to existing ones
* Knowledge of back‑end and front‑end development concepts
* Knowledge of foundational programming languages, technologies, or web development stacks
* Ability to work collaboratively to solve technical problems
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor’s degree

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience with gathering requirements or assisting in workflow automation
* Experience using languages such as Java, Python, C#, C++, .NET, JavaScript, React, NodeJS, PHP, or Drupal
* Knowledge of automated testing tools or unit testing frameworks
* Secret clearance
* Master’s degree

**Clearance:**  
Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
